summary: When the legacy UNIFI_GATEWAY_HOST chooses the gateway and UniFiTarget takes UNIFI_API_KEY as the local key, Load does not also apply UNIFI_API_KEY as the cloud credential, and that key still scopes the local store through StoreScopeIdentity.
reason: Earlier releases documented UNIFI_GATEWAY_HOST with the gateway's key in UNIFI_API_KEY. The generated env override still copied that key into UnifiApiKey, so Site Manager commands and bare sync sent the local gateway key to api.ui.com. The store name is derived from the cloud credential, so the key must keep naming it or an upgrade strands the existing data-<hash>.db.
validated_outcome: With UNIFI_GATEWAY_HOST and UNIFI_API_KEY set, `sites --dry-run` and `sync --dry-run` send no X-API-KEY to api.ui.com, `auth status` reports a local gateway key with no cloud key, `doctor` reports the same db_path as before the fix, and UNIFI_API_KEY remains the cloud key in every other env combination.
